target._comment: Fill in EITHER target_company_id (if the company is already in the dataset - check company_id values in eu_sustainability_sources_v5.json) OR new_company (if it isn't). Leave the other one as null. Delete this _comment line before submitting - it's not part of the schema.

entry._comment: entry_id: copy your submission_id here as a placeholder (it will be replaced automatically at merge time). source_type: one of downloadable_report | webpage | agr_section - see CONTRIBUTING.md for which field group to fill in for each. Every field below must be present even if null - do not delete keys, just set them to null. Delete this _comment line before submitting.

review._comment: Leave this whole block exactly as-is. Reviewers fill it in - do not set status to 'approved' yourself. Delete this _comment line before submitting.
